title_en: The Five Virtues of a General: Sun Tzu's Leadership Test for Direct Selling
title_zh: 將者五德：孫子給直銷領袖的領導力檢測
short_en: The Five Virtues of a General
excerpt_en: Wisdom, credibility, benevolence, courage, discipline. Sun Tzu listed five qualities of a general 2,500 years ago, and they still make the best check-up I know for anyone leading a team.
excerpt_zh: 智、信、仁、勇、嚴。孫子在兩千五百年前列出將領的五種特質，到今天，它們仍是我知道最好的領袖自我檢測。
description_en: Sun Tzu's five virtues of a general, applied to leading a direct selling team, with one honest question for each and a sign that the virtue is missing.
description_zh: 把孫子的「將者五德」應用在帶領直銷團隊上：每一德一個誠實的問題，以及它缺席時會出現的徵兆。
keywords: Sun Tzu five virtues, leadership qualities, direct selling leadership, wisdom credibility benevolence courage discipline, Mikael Chew, 將者五德
blocks: quote
The commander stands for the virtues of wisdom, sincerity, benevolence, courage and strictness.
將者，智、信、仁、勇、嚴也。
Sun Tzu
《孫子兵法・計篇》
p

In the very first chapter of The Art of War, Sun Tzu lists five things to assess before any battle. One of them is the general, and he describes a good one in five words: wise, credible, benevolent, courageous, disciplined.
在《孫子兵法》的第一篇，孫子列出開戰前要評估的五件事，其中一件就是將領。他用五個字描述一位好將領：智、信、仁、勇、嚴。
p
It's a short list, and a demanding one. Most leaders are strong in two or three and quietly weak in the rest. The weak ones are usually where the team's problems come from.
這張清單很短，卻很嚴格。大多數領袖在其中兩三項很強，其餘幾項悄悄地弱。而那些弱項，通常就是團隊問題的來源。
p
Here is how I read each virtue for someone leading a direct selling team, with one honest question to ask yourself and the sign that it's missing.
以下是我對每一德的解讀，對象是帶領直銷團隊的人。每一德附上一個你該誠實問自己的問題，以及它缺席時會出現的徵兆。
h2
智 Wisdom
智：智慧
p
Wisdom is the ability to see the situation clearly and choose the right response. It means knowing whether a problem is about tactics, strategy or purpose, and treating it accordingly.
智，是看清局勢、選擇正確回應的能力。它意味著分辨一個問題是戰術、戰略，還是目的層面的問題，然後對症下藥。
p
Ask yourself: when my team brings me a problem, do I diagnose it before I answer it?
問自己：團隊帶著問題來找我時，我是先診斷，還是直接給答案？
p
When it's missing: the same advice is given to every problem, usually "work harder".
它缺席時：每一個問題都得到同一個建議，通常是「再努力一點」。
h2
信 Credibility
信：誠信
p
Credibility means people can rely on what you say. Promises are kept, standards are applied fairly, and your words match your actions.
信，是大家可以依靠你說的話。承諾會兌現，標準公平地執行，言行一致。
p
Ask yourself: if my team listed the promises I made this month, how many would they say I kept?
問自己：如果團隊列出我這個月做過的承諾，他們會說我兌現了幾個？
p
When it's missing: people stop believing announcements and wait to see what actually happens.
它缺席時：大家不再相信你的宣布，而是等著看實際會發生什麼。
h2
仁 Benevolence
仁：仁愛
p
Benevolence is genuine care for the people you lead. It's checking in when someone is struggling, and caring about them as people rather than as numbers.
仁，是對你所帶領的人真心的關懷。是在有人辛苦時去問候他，是把他們當人來關心，而不是當數字。
p
Ask yourself: do my partners hear from me only when their numbers are good, or also when life is hard?
問自己：我的夥伴，只有在業績好的時候才聽到我的消息，還是在生活艱難的時候也會？
p
When it's missing: people stay while things go well and leave quietly the first time they don't.
它缺席時：順利的時候大家都在，第一次遇到不順，就悄悄離開。
h2
勇 Courage
勇：勇氣
p
Courage in a leader is rarely dramatic. It's having the difficult conversation, admitting a mistake in front of the team, and trying something new when the old way has stopped working.
領袖的勇氣，很少是轟轟烈烈的。它是去進行那場困難的對話、在團隊面前承認錯誤、在舊方法不再有效時嘗試新的做法。
p
Ask yourself: what conversation have I been avoiding for more than a month?
問自己：有哪一場對話，我已經逃避超過一個月了？
p
When it's missing: problems are discussed by everyone except the people involved.
它缺席時：每個人都在談論問題，除了當事人。
h2
嚴 Discipline
嚴：紀律
p
Discipline is holding a clear standard, starting with yourself. It's doing the daily basics you ask others to do, and being consistent about what the team will and won't accept.
嚴，是守住清楚的標準，從自己開始。它是做到你要求別人做的每日基本功，並且一致地堅持團隊能接受和不能接受的事。
p
Ask yourself: am I doing every day what I ask my newest partner to do?
問自己：我每天都在做我要求最新夥伴做的事嗎？
p
When it's missing: standards slide, and the most committed people lose heart first.
它缺席時：標準慢慢下滑，最投入的人最先灰心。
h2
The virtues balance each other
五德彼此平衡
p

The list works as a whole. Benevolence without discipline becomes softness that helps nobody. Discipline without benevolence becomes harshness people leave. Courage without wisdom becomes recklessness.
這張清單要整體來看。有仁無嚴，會變成幫不了任何人的軟弱。有嚴無仁，會變成讓人想離開的嚴苛。有勇無智，會變成魯莽。
p
That's why a leader who is strong in four and weak in one still struggles. The missing virtue throws the others off balance.
這就是為什麼，一位四德很強、一德很弱的領袖，仍然會吃力。缺席的那一德，會讓其他四德失去平衡。
p
Read the five questions again tonight and score yourself honestly from one to five on each. Which is your lowest, and what would your team say it is?
今晚再讀一次這五個問題，誠實地給自己每一項打一到五分。哪一項最低？你的團隊又會說是哪一項？

cta.p_zh: 我新書第十章深入探討將者五德，以及如何激勵並凝聚一支成長中的團隊。
